items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: He was playing … uh, bass. I mean, uh, in fact, uh, which brings to mind, most of the musicians I've met when I went to New Orleans played more than one instrument. More than two. I said, "My God, [how they do that?]," you know, to myself. I didn't know you could do that, I mean, uh, I had studied bass in, in college but I mean, I would never try to play a gig. I couldn't last, probably, with the blisters. But uh, but these, these, these guys were playing more than just one, one instrument, you know like uh,…
Did you meet James Bly? Did you ever hear about him down there?
Uh, I met him later. He wasn't around uh, during … 'cause I just stayed there one semester, and he might, I might have preceded him. I mean, yeah.
